text:
sasha: Heads-up: I ran a few continuous-batching experiments this morning focused on microburst fairness. Short requests are getting starved when a few long sequences hit the queue at once. Need eyes before I push to canary. :eyes:
ben: Can you paste the config you used?
maria: Yup please include perf numbers too (p50/p95, tokens/sec, kv hit rate).
sasha: Config snippet:```yaml
batching:
  token_budget_target: 96  # per-batch target tokens
  short_lane_reserved_tokens: 48  # reserve for short seqs
  smoothing_alpha: 0.25  # EWMA for credit refill
  max_batch_window_ms: 8
  min_batch_size_tokens: 16
  preemptive_slice_eviction: true
queue_policy:
  lane_precedence: [short, normal, long]
  tenant_credit_cap: 1024
```
kevin: Interesting. How did you compute the reserved_tokens number?
sasha: Quick heuristic: observed short seqs median=12 tokens, bursts ~3 reqs -> reserve ~36, rounded up + safety = 48. Also we use EWMA so it adapts.
raj: What about KV cache behavior? Long sequences inflate KV usage and slow the coalescer, right?
sasha: Exactly. KV hit rate drops on heavy long tails. I added a lightweight eviction hint: if a tenant's active short-lane hits >80% of reserved, we preempt LRU slices older than 30s for that tenant. That reduces KV churn for short-run path.
ben: Perf numbers?
sasha: Before: p95 latency=310ms, p50=42ms, tokens/s=18k, kv_hit=0.76. After (local cluster w/ reserve=48): p95=260ms, p50=46ms, tokens/s=17.6k, kv_hit=0.74. Short-request tail improved: short-p95 down from 420ms to 120ms. Long-request p95 increased slightly (~+10ms).
maria: Nice tradeoff. Did you measure tenant fairness? Any tenant-level starvation spikes?
sasha: Ran 4-tenant mixed workload 70/20/5/5 (short/normal/long/long-heavy): max per-tenant request delay dropped from 4.8s -> 1.1s for short-tenant. Long-heavy tenant saw 6% throughput dip but stayed within SLA.
kevin: Can we make token_budget_target auto-tune based on observed seq-length histogram?
sasha: Proposal: add an adaptive controller that adjusts token_budget_target per-device every minute using gradient-free step (if short-starvation_rate > 2% then decrease global target by 10%). Precompute safe min=64, max=256.
raj: Rollout plan? ci-bot: deploy-canary job scheduled. Please tag owners.
sasha: Plan: roll to 1 canary cluster, 24h soak with synthetic mixed workload + production shadowing. If short-p95 improves >=30% and long throughput drop <=10% -> promote.
ben: Also add tracing tag to batcher and KV eviction events so we can slice out regressions in trace.
maria: I'll add dashboards: short-p95, long-p95, kv_hit_by_tenant, tenant-delay-percentile.
sasha: Thanks. I'll open the PR with the controller stub and config + canary playbook. Anyone want to co-own the experiments?
kevin: I'll take monitoring and alerts.
raj: I'll validate KV eviction correctness and write a small fuzz test for slice preemption.
ben: I'll review the PR. :thumbsup:
sasha: Awesome — merging the experiment doc into the canary plan now. Ci-bot: starting canary run in 10m...
